ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-1,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District and RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 26-G in the area
bound by:

a line 73 feet south of and parallel to West 107" Street; South Loomis Street; and a line
100 feet west of and parallel to South Loomis Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Common Address:
10726-10750 S. Loomis Street
